26: 	// SpaCy: dep=nsubj (in math context), pos=SYM
27: 	MathSymbolVariable MathSymbol = 0x02
28: 
29: 	// MathSymbolOperator: an arithmetic or relational operator.
30: 	// SpaCy: dep=ROOT (where token value is an operator), pos=VERB
31: 	// The specific operator (add/mul/eq/lt/…) is encoded in Slots 0-3.
32: 	MathSymbolOperator MathSymbol = 0x04
33: )
34: 
35: // PackSlot4 builds the 32-bit Slot 4 register.
36: //
37: //	operatorByte — POS tag (non-math) or MathOperator (math mode); fills 0x000000FF.
38: //	jitterPayload — 24-bit value from FlashSearch; fills 0xFFFFFF00.
39: //
40: // The jitter payload is always injected regardless of domain. In Math Mode the
41: // operator byte must be a MathOperator constant; any value > 0xFF is truncated.
42: func PackSlot4(operatorByte uint8, jitterPayload uint32) uint32 {
43: 	return uint32(operatorByte) | ((jitterPayload & 0x00FFFFFF) << 8)
44: }
45: 
46: // UnpackSlot4 extracts the operator byte and jitter payload from a packed register.
47: func UnpackSlot4(reg uint32) (operatorByte uint8, jitterPayload uint32) {
48: 	operatorByte = uint8(reg & 0x000000FF)
49: 	jitterPayload = (reg >> 8) & 0x00FFFFFF
50: 	return
51: }
52: 
53: // TensorPacker orchestrates all 12 slots into the NeuralFrame binary.
54: type TensorPacker struct {
55: 	flashSearch *FlashSearchHelper
56: 	nrvKB       *NRVKnowledgeBase // 16-dim re-indexed NRV KB
57: }
58: 
59: // NewTensorPacker creates a new TensorPacker instance.
60: func NewTensorPacker() *TensorPacker {
61: 	return &TensorPacker{
62: 		flashSearch: &FlashSearchHelper{},
63: 		nrvKB:       &NRVKnowledgeBase{},
64: 	}
65: }
66: 
67: // Orchestrate builds the full 12-slot uint32 array for one bracket.
68: // It injects the Temporal Salt (Slot 11) and Flash Search jitter (Slot 4 upper bits).
69: func (tp *TensorPacker) Orchestrate(base *SlotVector, pos uint16, domainSig uint16) []uint32 {
70: 	slots := base.Copy()
71: 
72: 	// Slot 11: Temporal Salt — (PosIndex << 16) | TemporalSalt
73: 	salt := uint16(time.Now().UnixNano() & 0xFFFF)
74: 	slots[11] = uint32(pos) | (uint32(salt) << 16)
75: 
76: 	// Flash Search: use first 4 bytes of current hash state as lookup key.
77: 	jitter := tp.flashSearch.Lookup(slots[:4], tp.nrvKB)
78: 
79: 	// Slot 4: pack operator (0xFF zone) + jitter payload (0xFFFFFF zone).
80: 	var operatorByte uint8
81: 	if domainSig == DomainMath {
82: 		operatorByte = uint8(slots[4] & 0xFF) // preserve Math operator set by encoder
83: 	} else {
84: 		operatorByte = uint8(slots[4] & 0xFF) // POS/Grammar from nlp_bridge
85: 	}
86: 	slots[4] = PackSlot4(operatorByte, jitter)
87: 
88: 	return slots
89: }
90: 
91: // SaveTrainingFrames writes frames as .nrv Tier-3 Brackets into the
92: // encoder_output KNIRVBASE collection via the embedded NRVWriter.
93: func (tp *TensorPacker) SaveTrainingFrames(frames []*NeuralFrame, w *writer.NRVWriter) error {
94: 	for _, frame := range frames {
95: 		bracket := map[string]interface{}{
96: 			"Projections":   slotsToProjections(frame.Slots[:4]), // Slots 0-3 → 32 bytes
97: 			"SyntacticByte": uint8(frame.Slots[4] & 0xFF),        // Slot 4 operator byte
98: 			"DepHead":       uint8(frame.Slots[5]),               // Slot 5
99: 			"IntentFlags":   uint8(frame.Slots[9]),               // Slot 9
100: 			"DomainSig":     uint16(frame.Slots[10]),             // Slot 10
101: 			"ContextMemory": slots6to8(frame.Slots[6:9]),         // Slots 6-8 → 18 bytes
102: 			"GoldenSeed":    frame.Slots[11],                     // Slot 11 nonce
103: 			"DomainSig16":   uint16(frame.DomainSig),
104: 		}
105: 		if err := w.WriteBracket(bracket); err != nil {
106: 			return fmt.Errorf("saveTrainingFrames: frame %d: %w", frame.FrameID, err)
107: 		}
108: 	}

31: 		if len(sub) < 2 {

33: 		}
34: 		n, err := strconv.ParseUint(sub[1], 16, 8)

40: 			return "" // drop control characters
